integrity: The exact group-theoretic two-step graph isomorphism and gap enumeration prove the infinite family. A separate exact transfer determinant and independent finite open-neighborhood enumeration corroborate it; the finite runs alone do not prove the infinite theorem. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the usual circular ladder C_n Cartesian K_2 with n at least 3. Counts are of labeled vertex subsets and unordered maximum-packing partitions, not of arbitrary coloring partitions. A general graph-product formula and a standard cycle-square gap count are established antecedents; claims of comprehensive priority would be unwarranted.
title: Open-packing profiles and perfect partitions of circular ladders
